    // 3. HELPER UTILITIES (Toasts, Modals, Grade Calculation)
    function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
      const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
      const toast = document.createElement('div');
      const colors = {
        success: 'bg-[#059669] text-white border-emerald-400',
        warning: 'bg-[#D97706] text-white border-amber-400',
        error: 'bg-[#DC2626] text-white border-rose-400',
        info: 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white border-blue-400'
      };
      toast.className = `pointer-events-auto px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border shadow-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-all ${colors[type] || colors.info}`;
      toast.innerHTML = `<span>${message}</span>`;
      container.appendChild(toast);
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.remove();
      }, 3600);
    }

    function openModal(htmlContent) {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
      const content = document.getElementById('modalContent');
      content.innerHTML = htmlContent;
      overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
      overlay.classList.add('flex');
      const closeBtn = content.querySelector('[data-close-modal]');
      if (closeBtn) {
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      }
    }

    function closeModal() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
      overlay.classList.add('hidden');
      overlay.classList.remove('flex');
    }

    document.getElementById('modalOverlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === 'modalOverlay') closeModal();
    });

    function computeGrade(marks, maxMarks, passMarks) {
      const pct = Math.round((marks / maxMarks) * 100);
      if (marks < passMarks) return { grade: 'F (RA)', point: '0.0', isPass: false };
      if (pct >= 91) return { grade: 'A1', point: '10.0', isPass: true };
      if (pct >= 81) return { grade: 'A2', point: '9.0', isPass: true };
      if (pct >= 71) return { grade: 'B1', point: '8.0', isPass: true };
      if (pct >= 61) return { grade: 'B2', point: '7.0', isPass: true };
      if (pct >= 51) return { grade: 'C1', point: '6.0', isPass: true };
      return { grade: 'C2', point: '5.0', isPass: true };
    }

    function getActiveStudent() {
      return state.students.find(s => s.rollNo === state.activeStudentRoll) || state.students[0];
    }

    // 4. LANGUAGE & THEME CONTROLLERS
    function applyLanguage() {
      const dict = I18N[state.lang];
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
        const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
        if (dict[key]) el.textContent = dict[key];
      });
      document.getElementById('langToggleLabel').textContent = state.lang === 'en' ? 'தமிழ்' : 'English';
      renderAll();
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      state.dark = !state.dark;
      const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
      if (state.dark) {
        htmlEl.classList.add('dark');
        htmlEl.classList.remove('light');
        document.getElementById('themeIconSun').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('themeIconMoon').classList.add('hidden');
      } else {
        htmlEl.classList.remove('dark');
        htmlEl.classList.add('light');
        document.getElementById('themeIconSun').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('themeIconMoon').classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    }

    // 5. TOP-LEVEL MODE ROUTER ('auth' | 'student' | 'exam' | 'coe')
    function switchMode(newMode) {
      state.currentMode = newMode;
      const header = document.getElementById('mainHeader');
      const viewAuth = document.getElementById('viewAuth');
      const viewStudent = document.getElementById('viewStudent');
      const viewExam = document.getElementById('viewExam');
      const viewCoe = document.getElementById('viewCoe');
      const profileWrap = document.getElementById('studentProfileSelectorWrap');

      viewAuth.classList.add('hidden');
      viewStudent.classList.add('hidden');
      viewExam.classList.add('hidden');
      viewExam.classList.remove('flex');
      viewCoe.classList.add('hidden');

      // Distraction-Free Mode hides main header when inside Exam Room
      if (newMode === 'exam') {
        header.classList.add('hidden');
        viewExam.classList.remove('hidden');
        viewExam.classList.add('flex');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (newMode === 'auth') viewAuth.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (newMode === 'student') viewStudent.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (newMode === 'coe') viewCoe.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      if (newMode === 'student') {
        profileWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
        profileWrap.classList.add('flex');
      } else {
        profileWrap.classList.add('hidden');
      }

      // Highlight active mode button
      document.querySelectorAll('.mode-switch-btn').forEach(btn => {
        const target = btn.getAttribute('data-mode-btn');
        if (target === newMode) {
          btn.className = 'mode-switch-btn shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition bg-[#1E40AF] text-white shadow-xs';
        } else {
          btn.className = 'mode-switch-btn shrink-0 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800';
        }
      });

      renderAll();
    }

    // 6. STUDENT PORTAL RENDERERS
    function renderStudentSelector() {
      const sel = document.getElementById('activeStudentSelect');
      sel.innerHTML = state.students.map(s =>
        `<option value="${s.rollNo}" ${s.rollNo === state.activeStudentRoll ? 'selected' : ''}>
          ${s.fullName} (${s.rollNo} · Class ${s.currentClass} → Prep ${s.prepClass})
        </option>`
      ).join('');
    }

    function renderStudentPortal() {
      const stu = getActiveStudent();
      // Header Banner
      document.getElementById('stuBannerRoll').textContent = stu.rollNo;
      document.getElementById('stuBannerCurrentClass').textContent = state.lang === 'en'
        ? `Current School Class: Class ${stu.currentClass}`
        : `தற்போதைய வகுப்பு: வகுப்பு ${stu.currentClass}`;
      document.getElementById('stuBannerPrepClass').textContent = state.lang === 'en'
        ? `Preparation Programme: Class ${stu.prepClass} Samacheer Kalvi`
        : `தேர்வுத் தயாரிப்பு நிலை: வகுப்பு ${stu.prepClass} சமச்சீர் கல்வி`;
      document.getElementById('stuBannerMedium').textContent = `Medium: ${stu.medium}`;
      document.getElementById('stuBannerName').textContent = stu.fullName;
      document.getElementById('stuBannerSubtext').textContent = state.lang === 'en'
        ? `All syllabus units, previous-year question papers, worked solutions, and examination schedules are strictly isolated to Class ${stu.prepClass} Samacheer Kalvi.`
        : `உங்களுக்கான அனைத்துப் பாடத்திட்டங்களும் வினாத்தாள்களும் வகுப்பு ${stu.prepClass} சமச்சீர் கல்வித் தரத்திற்கு ஏற்ப வடிகட்டப்பட்டுள்ளன.`;

      // Filter syllabus chapters for this student's preparation class
      const classSyllabus = state.syllabus.filter(ch => ch.prepClass === stu.prepClass);
      const completedCount = classSyllabus.filter(ch => ch.completedBy.includes(stu.rollNo)).length;
      const totalCount = classSyllabus.length || 1;
      const pct = Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100);

      document.getElementById('overallProgressPct').textContent = `${pct}%`;
      document.getElementById('overallProgressBar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
      document.getElementById('overallChaptersCompletedLabel').textContent =
        `${completedCount} of ${classSyllabus.length} Listed Chapters Completed`;

      // Next Scheduled Exam Card
      const pubExams = state.exams.filter(ex => ex.prepClass === stu.prepClass && ex.status === 'PUBLISHED');
      if (pubExams.length > 0) {
        const nextEx = pubExams[0];
        document.getElementById('nextExamSubjectTitle').textContent = `${nextEx.subject} — (${nextEx.code})`;
        document.getElementById('nextExamMeta').textContent = `Date: ${nextEx.date} · ${nextEx.time} · Duration: ${nextEx.duration} Mins · Max Marks: ${nextEx.maxMarks}`;
      }

      // Notices filtered by prepClass
      const noticesEl = document.getElementById('studentNoticesList');
      const classNotices = state.notices.filter(n => n.prepClass === stu.prepClass);
      noticesEl.innerHTML = classNotices.map(n => `
        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0F172A] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs">
          <div class="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">${n.date}</div>
          <div class="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 mt-0.5">${state.lang === 'en' ? n.textEn : n.textTa}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      // 5 Assigned Subjects Bento Grid
      document.getElementById('fiveSubjectsLevelTag').textContent = `Class ${stu.prepClass} Samacheer Kalvi · 5 Assigned Subjects`;
      const bentoGrid = document.getElementById('studentSubjectsBentoGrid');
      bentoGrid.innerHTML = stu.subjects.map((sub, idx) => {
        const subChaps = classSyllabus.filter(c => c.subject.toLowerCase().includes(sub.nameEn.toLowerCase()) || sub.nameEn.toLowerCase().includes(c.subject.toLowerCase()));
        const subDone = subChaps.filter(c => c.completedBy.includes(stu.rollNo)).length;
        const subPct = subChaps.length ? Math.round((subDone / subChaps.length) * 100) : 50;
        const subPapers = state.papers.filter(p => p.prepClass === stu.prepClass && p.subject.toLowerCase() === sub.nameEn.toLowerCase() && p.paperPublished);
        const subExam = pubExams.find(e => e.subject.toLowerCase() === sub.nameEn.toLowerCase());

        return `
          <div class="bento-card p-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
                <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 dark:bg-sky-500/15 text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-300 font-mono text-xs font-bold">
                  0${idx + 1} · ${sub.code}
                </span>
                <span class="text-xs font-bold text-[#0D9488]">${subPct}% Studied</span>
              </div>
              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                ${state.lang === 'en' ? sub.nameEn : sub.nameTa}
              </h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                ${sub.nameEn} · Class ${stu.prepClass} Board Standard
              </p>

              <div class="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 overflow-hidden mt-3">
                <div class="h-full bg-[#1E40AF] dark:bg-sky-400 rounded-full" style="width: ${subPct}%"></div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span class="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                ${subPapers.length} Public Paper(s) · ${subExam ? `Exam: ${subExam.date}` : 'Schedule Pending'}
              </span>
              <button type="button" data-open-subject="${sub.nameEn}" class="font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400 hover:underline">
                Open Syllabus →
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      // Attach listeners for "Open Syllabus" buttons on bento cards
      bentoGrid.querySelectorAll('[data-open-subject]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          switchStudentTab('syllabus');
        });
      });

      // Populate Syllabus Subject Filter & Chapters List
      const filterSelect = document.getElementById('syllabusSubjectFilter');
      const currentFilter = filterSelect.value || 'ALL';
      const uniqueSubjects = [...new Set(classSyllabus.map(c => c.subject))];
      filterSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="ALL">All Assigned Class ${stu.prepClass} Subjects</option>` +
        uniqueSubjects.map(s => `<option value="${s}" ${s === currentFilter ? 'selected' : ''}>${s}</option>`).join('');

      const filteredChapters = currentFilter === 'ALL'
        ? classSyllabus
        : classSyllabus.filter(c => c.subject === currentFilter);

      const syllabusContainer = document.getElementById('syllabusChaptersContainer');
      syllabusContainer.innerHTML = filteredChapters.map(ch => {
        const isDone = ch.completedBy.includes(stu.rollNo);
        return `
          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border ${isDone ? 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/5' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#0F172A]'} flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
              <input type="checkbox" data-toggle-chap="${ch.id}" ${isDone ? 'checked' : ''} class="mt-1 w-4 h-4 rounded text-[#059669] cursor-pointer" />
              <div>
                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${ch.subject} · Chapter ${ch.chapNo}</span>
                  <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono">Weightage: ${ch.weightage} Marks</span>
                </div>
                <h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1">${ch.titleEn}</h4>
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">${ch.titleTa}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold ${isDone ? 'bg-[#059669] text-white' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300'}">
                ${isDone ? '✓ Completed' : '○ Pending Revision'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      syllabusContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-chap]').forEach(chk => {
        chk.addEventListener('change', () => {
          const chapId = chk.getAttribute('data-toggle-chap');
          const chap = state.syllabus.find(c => c.id === chapId);
          if (chap) {
            if (chk.checked) {
              if (!chap.completedBy.includes(stu.rollNo)) chap.completedBy.push(stu.rollNo);
              showToast(`Marked "${chap.titleEn}" as completed!`, 'success');
            } else {
              chap.completedBy = chap.completedBy.filter(r => r !== stu.rollNo);
            }
            renderStudentPortal();
          }
        });
      });

      // Populate Previous-Year Question Papers & Worked Solutions
      const papersContainer = document.getElementById('studentPapersContainer');
      const stuPapers = state.papers.filter(p => p.prepClass === stu.prepClass && p.paperPublished);
      papersContainer.innerHTML = stuPapers.map(p => `
        <div class="bento-card p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
          <div>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
              <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-sky-500/15 text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-300 font-mono text-xs font-bold">${p.id}</span>
              <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">${p.year} · ${p.session}</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${p.subject} — Class ${p.prepClass} Public Question Paper</h3>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Source Attribution: ${p.boardSource}</p>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mt-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              <span>Max Marks: ${p.maxMarks}</span>
              <span>·</span>
              <span>Duration: ${p.durationMins} Mins</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <button type="button" data-view-paper="${p.id}" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1E40AF] text-white text-xs font-bold">
              📄 View Question Paper
            </button>
            ${p.solutionPublished
              ? `<button type="button" data-view-solution="${p.id}" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#059669] text-white text-xs font-bold">✓ View COE Worked Solution</button>`
              : `<span class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-[#D97706] text-xs font-bold">○ Solution Locked by COE</span>`
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      papersContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-view-paper]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const p = state.papers.find(x => x.id === btn.getAttribute('data-view-paper'));
          openModal(`
            <div class="space-y-4">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div>
                  <span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${p.id}</span>
                  <h3 class="text-lg font-extrabold">${p.subject} (${p.year} ${p.session})</h3>
                </div>
                <button type="button" data-close-modal class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold">Close</button>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Official Source: ${p.boardSource}</p>
              <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0F172A] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-2">
                <div class="font-bold">Blueprint Structure (Class ${p.prepClass} Samacheer Kalvi):</div>
                <div>• Part I: 14 × 1 = 14 Marks (Objective MCQs)</div>
                <div>• Part II: 10 × 2 = 20 Marks (Short Answer Questions)</div>
                <div>• Part III: 10 × 5 = 50 Marks (Analytical / Derivation Questions)</div>
                <div>• Part IV: 2 × 8 = 16 Marks (Long Geometry / Graph / Essay Questions)</div>
              </div>
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button type="button" id="modalLaunchPracticeBtn" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1E40AF] text-white text-xs font-bold">Attempt Paper in Distraction-Free Exam UI →</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          `);
          const launchBtn = document.getElementById('modalLaunchPracticeBtn');
          if (launchBtn) {
            launchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              closeModal();
              switchMode('exam');
            });
          }
        });
      });

      papersContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-view-solution]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const p = state.papers.find(x => x.id === btn.getAttribute('data-view-solution'));
          openModal(`
            <div class="space-y-4">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div>
                  <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/15 text-[#059669] text-xs font-bold">✓ COE Verified Worked Key</span>
                  <h3 class="text-lg font-extrabold mt-1">${p.subject} (${p.year}) — Worked Solutions</h3>
                </div>
                <button type="button" data-close-modal class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold">Close</button>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">${p.solutionSummary}</p>
              <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 text-xs font-mono">
                Q1 Answer: Option C (3) — Step: n(B) = n(A × B) / n(A) = 6 / 2 = 3.<br/>
                Q2 Answer: Option C (2 / 9x²) — Step: f(g(x)) = 2 × (1 / 3x)² = 2 / 9x².
              </div>
            </div>
          `);
        });
      });

      // Populate 5-Subject Exam Schedule Table
      const schedBody = document.getElementById('studentScheduleTableBody');
      schedBody.innerHTML = pubExams.map(ex => `
        <tr>
          <td class="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${ex.code}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${ex.subject}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3 font-mono">${ex.date} · ${ex.time}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3">${ex.duration} Mins</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3 font-mono">${ex.maxMarks} / ${ex.passMarks}</td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3">
            <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-[#059669] dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-[11px]">
              ✓ ${ex.status}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-3 px-3 text-right">
            <button type="button" data-start-scheduled-exam="${ex.code}" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] text-white font-bold text-xs">
              Enter Room →
            </button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      schedBody.querySelectorAll('[data-start-scheduled-exam]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          switchMode('exam');
        });
      });

      // Populate Published Results & Grade Card
      const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('studentResultsContainer');
      const stuPublishedResults = state.results.filter(r => r.rollNo === stu.rollNo && r.publishStatus === 'PUBLISHED');
      const stuWithheldCount = state.results.filter(r => r.rollNo === stu.rollNo && r.publishStatus !== 'PUBLISHED').length;

      resultsContainer.innerHTML = stuPublishedResults.map(r => {
        const g = computeGrade(r.marksObtained, r.maxMarks, r.passMarks);
        return `
          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#0F172A] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-xs font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${r.examTitle}</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-[#059669] text-[11px] font-bold">✓ Published</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1">${r.subject} (Class ${r.prepClass} Standard)</h4>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">COE Remarks: "${r.coeRemarks}"</p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div class="text-right">
                <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold">Score</div>
                <div class="font-mono text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${r.marksObtained} / ${r.maxMarks}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#059669] text-white text-center font-mono">
                <div class="text-[10px] uppercase">Grade</div>
                <div class="text-base font-extrabold">${g.grade}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('') + (stuWithheldCount > 0 ? `
        <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-[#D97706] dark:text-amber-300 text-xs font-semibold">
          ! ${stuWithheldCount} additional subject result(s) are currently in COE Evaluation / Withheld status and will appear automatically once published.
        </div>
      ` : '');
    }

    function switchStudentTab(tabName) {
      state.studentSubTab = tabName;
      const tabs = {
        overview: 'stuSubOverview',
        syllabus: 'stuSubSyllabus',
        papers: 'stuSubPapers',
        schedule: 'stuSubSchedule',
        results: 'stuSubResults'
      };
      Object.entries(tabs).forEach(([k, id]) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (k === tabName) el.classList.remove('hidden');
        else el.classList.add('hidden');
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.stu-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        if (btn.getAttribute('data-stu-tab') === tabName) {
          btn.className = 'stu-tab-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl transition bg-[#1E40AF] text-white';
        } else {
          btn.className = 'stu-tab-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl transition text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800';
        }
      });
    }

    // 7. DISTRACTION-FREE ONLINE EXAM ENGINE RENDERER
    function renderExamEngine() {
      const stu = getActiveStudent();
      document.getElementById('examCandidateName').textContent = `${stu.fullName} (${stu.rollNo})`;

      const q = state.examQuestions[state.activeQuestionIndex];
      if (!q) return;

      // If visiting for the first time, transition from 'not_visited' to 'unanswered'
      if (q.status === 'not_visited') {
        q.status = 'unanswered';
      }

      document.getElementById('examQNumberLabel').textContent = `Question ${q.qNo} of ${state.examQuestions.length}`;
      document.getElementById('examQPartBadge').textContent = q.part;
      document.getElementById('examQChapterBadge').textContent = q.chapter;
      document.getElementById('examQMarksBadge').textContent = `+${q.marks} Mark${q.marks > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
      document.getElementById('examQStemEn').textContent = q.stemEn;
      document.getElementById('examQStemTa').textContent = q.stemTa;

      // Render Options
      const optsContainer = document.getElementById('examQOptionsContainer');
      optsContainer.innerHTML = q.options.map(opt => {
        const isSelected = q.selectedOption === opt.key;
        return `
          <button type="button" data-select-opt="${opt.key}" class="w-full text-left p-4 rounded-xl border transition flex items-center gap-3.5 ${
            isSelected
              ? 'border-[#1E40AF] dark:border-sky-400 bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-sky-500/15 font-bold'
              : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60'
          }">
            <span class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-xs font-bold ${
              isSelected ? 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white border-[#1E40AF]' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
            }">${opt.key}</span>
            <span class="text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${opt.text}</span>
          </button>
        `;
      }).join('');

      optsContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-select-opt]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const chosen = btn.getAttribute('data-select-opt');
          q.selectedOption = chosen;
          q.status = 'answered';
          document.getElementById('examAutoSaveTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
          renderExamEngine();
        });
      });

      // Update Question Navigator Grid & Colorblind-Safe Status Counts
      const counts = { answered: 0, unanswered: 0, review: 0, not_visited: 0 };
      state.examQuestions.forEach(item => {
        counts[item.status] = (counts[item.status] || 0) + 1;
      });
      document.getElementById('navCountAnswered').textContent = counts.answered;
      document.getElementById('navCountUnanswered').textContent = counts.unanswered;
      document.getElementById('navCountReview').textContent = counts.review;
      document.getElementById('navCountNotVisited').textContent = counts.not_visited;

      const navGrid = document.getElementById('examNavigatorGrid');
      navGrid.innerHTML = state.examQuestions.map((item, idx) => {
        const isCurrent = idx === state.activeQuestionIndex;
        let style = 'border border-dashed border-slate-400 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400';
        let symbol = '○';
        if (item.status === 'answered') {
          style = 'bg-[#059669] text-white';
          symbol = '✓';
        } else if (item.status === 'review') {
          style = 'bg-[#7C3AED] text-white';
          symbol = '★';
        } else if (item.status === 'unanswered') {
          style = 'bg-[#D97706] text-white';
          symbol = '!';
        }
        return `
          <button type="button" data-jump-q="${idx}" class="h-11 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition ${style} ${isCurrent ? 'ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#1E40AF] dark:ring-sky-400' : ''}">
            <span>${symbol}</span>
            <span>${item.qNo}</span>
          </button>
        `;
      }).join('');

      navGrid.querySelectorAll('[data-jump-q]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          state.activeQuestionIndex = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-jump-q'), 10);
          renderExamEngine();
        });
      });
    }

    // 8. COE ADMIN PANEL RENDERER
    function renderCoePanel() {
      // Update Pending Registration Badges
      const pendingCount = state.pendingRegistrations.length;
      document.getElementById('pendingRegBadgeTop').textContent = pendingCount;
      document.getElementById('coeTabPendingCount').textContent = pendingCount;

      // 1. Render Pending Registrations Queue
      const pendingList = document.getElementById('coePendingRegistrationsList');
      if (pendingCount === 0) {
        pendingList.innerHTML = `
          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0F172A] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-500">
            No pending student registration requests in queue. All candidates have been verified.
          </div>
        `;
      } else {
        pendingList.innerHTML = state.pendingRegistrations.map(reg => `
          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div class="space-y-1">
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold">! PENDING COE APPROVAL</span>
                <span class="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${reg.rollNo}</span>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-400">Submitted: ${reg.submittedAt}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 class="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${reg.fullName}</h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                Current Class: <strong>Class ${reg.currentClass}</strong> → Assigned Preparation Level: <strong>Class ${reg.prepClass} Samacheer Kalvi</strong> · Preferred UI/Exam Language: <strong>${reg.preferredLang === 'ta' ? 'தமிழ் (Tamil)' : 'English'}</strong>
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button type="button" data-approve-reg="${reg.id}" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#059669] hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold transition">
                ✓ Approve & Activate 5 Subjects
              </button>
              <button type="button" data-reject-reg="${reg.id}" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/40 text-[#DC2626] text-xs font-bold hover:bg-rose-500/10 transition">
                ✕ Reject
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      }

      pendingList.querySelectorAll('[data-approve-reg]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const regId = btn.getAttribute('data-approve-reg');
          const idx = state.pendingRegistrations.findIndex(r => r.id === regId);
          if (idx !== -1) {
            const reg = state.pendingRegistrations[idx];
            const defaultSubjects = reg.prepClass === 10
              ? [
                  { code: 'TN10-TAM', nameEn: 'Tamil', nameTa: 'தமிழ்' },
                  { code: 'TN10-ENG', nameEn: 'English', nameTa: 'ஆங்கிலம்' },
                  { code: 'TN10-MATH', nameEn: 'Mathematics', nameTa: 'கணிதம்' },
                  { code: 'TN10-SCI', nameEn: 'Science', nameTa: 'அறிவியல்' },
                  { code: 'TN10-SOC', nameEn: 'Social Science', nameTa: 'சமூக அறிவியல்' }
                ]
              : [
                  { code: 'TN12-TAM', nameEn: 'General Tamil', nameTa: 'பொதுத் தமிழ்' },
                  { code: 'TN12-ENG', nameEn: 'General English', nameTa: 'பொது ஆங்கிலம்' },
                  { code: 'TN12-MATH', nameEn: 'Mathematics', nameTa: 'கணிதம்' },
                  { code: 'TN12-PHY', nameEn: 'Physics', nameTa: 'இயற்பியல்' },
                  { code: 'TN12-CHE', nameEn: 'Chemistry', nameTa: 'வேதியியல்' }
                ];

            state.students.push({
              rollNo: reg.rollNo,
              fullName: reg.fullName,
              dob: reg.dob,
              currentClass: reg.currentClass,
              prepClass: reg.prepClass,
              preferredLang: reg.preferredLang,
              medium: reg.preferredLang === 'ta' ? 'Tamil' : 'English',
              academicYear: '2026-2027',
              subjects: defaultSubjects
            });
            state.pendingRegistrations.splice(idx, 1);
            showToast(`Approved ${reg.fullName} (${reg.rollNo}) for Class ${reg.prepClass} Preparation!`, 'success');
            renderAll();
          }
        });
      });

      pendingList.querySelectorAll('[data-reject-reg]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const regId = btn.getAttribute('data-reject-reg');
          state.pendingRegistrations = state.pendingRegistrations.filter(r => r.id !== regId);
          showToast('Registration request removed from queue.', 'warning');
          renderAll();
        });
      });

      // 2. Render Approved Students & Independent Class vs Prep Class Config
      const approvedList = document.getElementById('coeApprovedStudentsList');
      approvedList.innerHTML = state.students.map(s => `
        <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#0F172A] space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <span class="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${s.rollNo}</span>
              <h3 class="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${s.fullName}</h3>
            </div>
            <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-[#059669] text-[11px] font-bold">✓ Active</span>
          </div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div class="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 font-bold">Current School Class</div>
              <div class="font-bold mt-0.5">Class ${s.currentClass}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#1E293B] border border-emerald-500/30">
              <div class="text-[10px] uppercase text-[#059669] font-bold">Exam Prep Syllabus</div>
              <div class="font-extrabold text-[#059669] mt-0.5">Class ${s.prepClass} Samacheer</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1">
            <span class="text-slate-500">Medium: <strong>${s.medium}</strong> · 5 Subjects Mapped</span>
            <button type="button" data-toggle-prep-level="${s.rollNo}" class="text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400 font-bold hover:underline">
              Switch Prep Level (${s.prepClass === 10 ? '→ 12' : '→ 10'})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      approvedList.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-prep-level]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const roll = btn.getAttribute('data-toggle-prep-level');
          const stu = state.students.find(x => x.rollNo === roll);
          if (stu) {
            stu.prepClass = stu.prepClass === 10 ? 12 : 10;
            showToast(`Updated ${stu.fullName}'s Preparation Level to Class ${stu.prepClass}.`, 'info');
            renderAll();
          }
        });
      });

      // 3. Render COE Syllabus Repository
      const sylContainer = document.getElementById('coeSyllabusTableContainer');
      sylContainer.innerHTML = state.syllabus.map(ch => `
        <div class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div>
            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 dark:bg-sky-500/15 text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-300 font-mono font-bold">Prep Class ${ch.prepClass}</span>
            <span class="font-bold ml-1.5">${ch.subject} · Ch ${ch.chapNo}: ${ch.titleEn}</span>
            <div class="text-slate-500 mt-0.5">${ch.titleTa} · Weightage: ${ch.weightage}M</div>
          </div>
          <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-[#059669] font-bold text-[11px]">✓ Published</span>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      // 4. Render COE Papers & Independent Worked Solution Toggles
      const coePapersList = document.getElementById('coePapersControlList');
      coePapersList.innerHTML = state.papers.map(p => `
        <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs">
          <div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="font-mono font-bold text-[#1E40AF] dark:text-sky-400">${p.id}</span>
              <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 font-bold">Prep Class ${p.prepClass}</span>
            </div>
            <h4 class="font-extrabold text-sm mt-1">${p.subject} (${p.year} ${p.session})</h4>
            <p class="text-slate-500">${p.boardSource}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <button type="button" data-coe-toggle-paper="${p.id}" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold ${p.paperPublished ? 'bg-[#059669] text-white' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'}">
              Paper: ${p.paperPublished ? '✓ Published' : '○ Hidden'}
            </button>
            <button type="button" data-coe-toggle-sol="${p.id}" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold ${p.solutionPublished ? 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white' : 'bg-amber-500/15 text-[#D97706] border border-amber-500/30'}">
              Worked Solution: ${p.solutionPublished ? '✓ Unlocked' : '🔒 Locked'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      coePapersList.querySelectorAll('[data-coe-toggle-paper]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const p = state.papers.find(x => x.id === btn.getAttribute('data-coe-toggle-paper'));
          if (p) {
            p.paperPublished = !p.paperPublished;
            showToast(`${p.id} Question Paper visibility set to ${p.paperPublished ? 'Published' : 'Hidden'}.`, 'info');
            renderAll();
          }
        });
      });

      coePapersList.querySelectorAll('[data-coe-toggle-sol]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const p = state.papers.find(x => x.id === btn.getAttribute('data-coe-toggle-sol'));

1: import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
2: import { jwtVerify } from "jose";
3: 
4: const SESSION_SECRET = new TextEncoder().encode(
5:   process.env.SESSION_SECRET || "tn-samacheer-kalvi-coe-super-secret-key-2026-secure-32chars"
6: );
7: 
8: const COOKIE_NAME = "exam_portal_session";
9: 
10: export async function middleware(request) {
11:   const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
12: 
13:   // Only protect /student and /coe-admin paths
14:   const isStudentRoute = pathname.startsWith("/student");
15:   const isCOERoute = pathname.startsWith("/coe-admin");
16: 
17:   if (!isStudentRoute && !isCOERoute) {
18:     return NextResponse.next();
19:   }
20: 
21:   const sessionToken = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
22: 
23:   if (!sessionToken) {
24:     const loginUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
25:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("redirect", pathname);
26:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "authentication_required");
27:     return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
28:   }
29: 
30:   try {
31:     const { payload } = await jwtVerify(sessionToken, SESSION_SECRET);
32: 
33:     // COE Admin route guard: Strictly require ADMIN role
34:     if (isCOERoute && payload.role !== "ADMIN") {
35:       const homeUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
36:       homeUrl.searchParams.set("error", "admin_access_denied");
37:       return NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl);
38:     }
39: 
40:     // Student route guard: Allow STUDENTS (and allow ADMIN to preview)
41:     if (isStudentRoute && payload.role !== "STUDENT" && payload.role !== "ADMIN") {
42:       const homeUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
43:       homeUrl.searchParams.set("error", "student_access_denied");
44:       return NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl);
45:     }
46: 
47:     // Attach verified session header for downstream usage
48:     const response = NextResponse.next();
49:     response.headers.set("x-user-id", payload.userId);
50:     response.headers.set("x-user-role", payload.role);
51:     return response;
52:   } catch (err) {
53:     // Token tampered with or expired
54:     const loginUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
55:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "session_expired");
56:     const response = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
57:     response.cookies.delete(COOKIE_NAME);
58:     return response;
59:   }
60: }
61: 
62: export const config = {
63:   matcher: ["/student/:path*", "/coe-admin/:path*"],
64: };

6: 
7: export async function POST(request) {
8:   try {
9:     const body = await request.json();
10:     const { rollNo, dob } = body;
11: 
12:     if (!rollNo || !dob) {
13:       return NextResponse.json(
14:         { error: "Roll Number and Date of Birth are both required." },
15:         { status: 400 }
16:       );
17:     }
18: 
19:     const cleanRollNo = rollNo.trim().toUpperCase();
20:     const cleanDob = dob.trim(); // Format: YYYY-MM-DD
21: 
22:     // 1. Rate limiting check (max 5 failed attempts per roll number)
23:     const rateLimit = checkRateLimit(`student_${cleanRollNo}`);
24:     if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
25:       return NextResponse.json(
26:         {
27:           error: `Too many failed login attempts. Please wait ${rateLimit.retryAfterSeconds} seconds before trying again.`,
28:         },
29:         { status: 429 }
30:       );
31:     }
32: 
33:     // 2. Fetch student user
34:     const user = await db.user.findFirst({
35:       where: {
36:         username: cleanRollNo,
37:         role: "STUDENT",
38:       },
39:       include: {
40:         profile: true,
41:       },
42:     });
43: 
44:     if (!user || !user.profile) {
45:       return NextResponse.json(
46:         { error: "Invalid Roll Number or credentials." },
47:         { status: 401 }
48:       );
49:     }
50: 
51:     // 3. Compare DOB against bcrypt passwordHash
52:     const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(cleanDob, user.passwordHash);
53:     if (!isMatch) {
54:       return NextResponse.json(
55:         {
56:           error: `Incorrect Date of Birth. ${rateLimit.remainingAttempts} attempts remaining.`,
57:         },
58:         { status: 401 }
59:       );
60:     }
61: 
62:     // 4. Reset rate limiter on successful match
63:     resetRateLimit(`student_${cleanRollNo}`);
64: 
65:     // 5. Sign session token
66:     const sessionPayload = {
67:       userId: user.id,
68:       username: user.username,
69:       role: "STUDENT",
70:       profileId: user.profile.id,
71:       fullName: user.profile.fullName,
72:       currentClass: user.profile.currentClass,
73:       examPrepClass: user.profile.examPrepClass,
74:       board: user.profile.board,
75:       medium: user.profile.medium,
76:     };
77: 
78:     const token = await signSession(sessionPayload);
79: 
80:     // 6. Return response with HTTP-only cookie
81:     const response = NextResponse.json({
82:       success: true,
83:       message: `Welcome, ${user.profile.fullName}!`,
84:       user: sessionPayload,
85:     });
86: 
87:     const cookieOptions = getSessionCookieOptions();
88:     response.cookies.set(cookieOptions.name, token, cookieOptions);
89: 
90:     return response;
91:   } catch (error) {
92:     console.error("Student login error:", error);
93:     return NextResponse.json(
94:       { error: "Internal server error during authentication." },
95:       { status: 500 }
96:     );
97:   }

3: import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";
4: 
5: const ThemeContext = createContext({
6:   theme: "dark",
7:   toggleTheme: () => {},
8: });
9: 
10: export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
11:   const [theme, setTheme] = useState("dark");
12:   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
13: 
14:   useEffect(() => {
15:     setMounted(true);
16:     const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("exam_portal_theme") || "dark";
17:     setTheme(savedTheme);
18:     if (savedTheme === "dark") {
19:       document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
20:     } else {
21:       document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
22:     }
23:   }, []);
24: 
25:   const toggleTheme = () => {
26:     const nextTheme = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
27:     setTheme(nextTheme);
28:     localStorage.setItem("exam_portal_theme", nextTheme);
29:     if (nextTheme === "dark") {
30:       document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
31:     } else {
32:       document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
33:     }
34:   };
35: 
36:   return (
37:     <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme, mounted }}>
38:       {children}
39:     </ThemeContext.Provider>
40:   );
41: }
42: 
43: export function useTheme() {
44:   return useContext(ThemeContext);
45: }

10: export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
11:   const [theme, setTheme] = useState("dark");
12:   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
13: 
14:   useEffect(() => {
15:     setMounted(true);
16:     const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("exam_portal_theme") || "dark";
17:     setTheme(savedTheme);
18:     if (savedTheme === "dark") {
19:       document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
20:     } else {
21:       document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
22:     }
23:   }, []);
24: 
25:   const toggleTheme = () => {
26:     const nextTheme = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
27:     setTheme(nextTheme);
28:     localStorage.setItem("exam_portal_theme", nextTheme);
29:     if (nextTheme === "dark") {
30:       document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
31:     } else {
32:       document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
33:     }
34:   };
35: 
36:   return (
37:     <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme, mounted }}>
38:       {children}
39:     </ThemeContext.Provider>
40:   );
41: }
42: 
43: export function useTheme() {
44:   return useContext(ThemeContext);

10: export async function middleware(request) {
11:   const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
12: 
13:   // Only protect /student and /coe-admin paths
14:   const isStudentRoute = pathname.startsWith("/student");
15:   const isCOERoute = pathname.startsWith("/coe-admin");
16: 
17:   if (!isStudentRoute && !isCOERoute) {
18:     return NextResponse.next();
19:   }
20: 
21:   const sessionToken = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
22: 
23:   if (!sessionToken) {
24:     const loginUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
25:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("redirect", pathname);
26:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "authentication_required");
27:     return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
28:   }
29: 
30:   try {
31:     const { payload } = await jwtVerify(sessionToken, SESSION_SECRET);
32: 
33:     // COE Admin route guard: Strictly require ADMIN role
34:     if (isCOERoute && payload.role !== "ADMIN") {
35:       const homeUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
36:       homeUrl.searchParams.set("error", "admin_access_denied");
37:       return NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl);
38:     }
39: 
40:     // Student route guard: Allow STUDENTS (and allow ADMIN to preview)
41:     if (isStudentRoute && payload.role !== "STUDENT" && payload.role !== "ADMIN") {
42:       const homeUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
43:       homeUrl.searchParams.set("error", "student_access_denied");
44:       return NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl);
45:     }
46: 
47:     // Attach verified session header for downstream usage
48:     const response = NextResponse.next();
49:     response.headers.set("x-user-id", payload.userId);
50:     response.headers.set("x-user-role", payload.role);
51:     return response;
52:   } catch (err) {
53:     // Token tampered with or expired
54:     const loginUrl = new URL("/", request.url);
55:     loginUrl.searchParams.set("reason", "session_expired");
56:     const response = NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
57:     response.cookies.delete(COOKIE_NAME);
58:     return response;
59:   }

### Academic Examination & Controller of Examinations (COE) System
**Curriculum & Examination Data Ingestion Specification**

The entire portal has been verified and refined:

1. **Strictly Professional Nomenclature**: All personal references ("brother", "sister") have been completely removed across all code, labels, navigation, and databases. The system operates strictly as an institutional **Controller of Examinations (COE)** and **Candidate** platform for Secondary (Class 10) and Higher Secondary (Class 12) Tamil Nadu Samacheer Kalvi standards.
2. **Student Self-Registration & Private COE Approval Workflow**:
   - New students can register directly from the portal home page (`/`) by submitting:
     - **Full Name**
     - **Roll Number** (e.g., `TN2026-0901`)
     - **Date of Birth** (used as their sign-in credential)
     - **Preferred Exam Language** (`Tamil` or `English`)
   - All newly registered candidates are placed in `PENDING` status with zero unauthorized access.
   - Registrations route privately to the **COE Student Management Panel** ([/coe-admin/students](http://localhost:3000/coe-admin/students)), where the COE reviews applicants, assigns their school grade (Class 9 or 11) and exam preparation level (Class 10 or 12), and approves them. Upon approval, their 5 core subjects are automatically assigned from the database.
3. **Cleaned Messaging**: All user-facing references to underlying technologies (such as mentions of "SQLite database" or "encrypted in SQLite" in notifications) have been excised and replaced with clean, academic institutional phrasing.
4. **Batch JSON Import Engine & Dedicated COE Tool**: A unified batch import API (`/api/admin/import`) and graphical interface ([/coe-admin/import](http://localhost:3000/coe-admin/import)) are now available for importing curriculum, question papers, and examination tests directly.

The complete architecture and schema guide has been saved to [implementation_plan.md](file:///C:/Users/adhav/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/884387c4-bbff-4b94-a621-f26ee7ea4f09/implementation_plan.md).

### Standard JSON Formats for Your Data

You can prepare your syllabus, past question papers, and exam schedules in the following 3 JSON structures.

---

#### 1. Syllabus Curriculum JSON (`type: "syllabus"`)

Use this structure to define subjects, units, and chapters:

```json
[
  {
    "subjectCode": "MAT-10",
    "name": "Mathematics",
    "prepClass": 10,
    "medium": "English",
    "units": [
      {
        "unitNumber": 1,
        "title": "Relations and Functions",
        "chapters": [
          {
            "chapterNumber": 1,
            "title": "Ordered Pairs and Cartesian Products",
            "description": "Definition of cartesian product, representation through arrow diagrams and matrices."
          },
          {
            "chapterNumber": 2,
            "title": "Functions and Types of Functions",
            "description": "One-one, onto, bijection, composite functions, and linear mappings."
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "unitNumber": 2,
        "title": "Numbers and Sequences",
        "chapters": [
          {
            "chapterNumber": 1,
            "title": "Euclid's Division Lemma & Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic",
            "description": "HCF algorithms and prime factor decomposition."
          },
          {
            "chapterNumber": 2,
            "title": "Arithmetic Progression (AP)",
            "description": "General term, common difference, and sum to n terms."
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

* **Standard Subject Codes**:
  * **Class 10**: `MAT-10` (Maths), `SCI-10` (Science), `SOC-10` (Social Science), `ENG-10` (English), `TAM-10` (Tamil).
  * **Class 12**: `MAT-12` (Maths), `PHY-12` (Physics), `CHE-12` (Chemistry), `BIO-12` (Biology), `ENG-12` (English).

---

#### 2. Previous-Year Question Papers & Worked Solutions JSON (`type: "papers"`)

Use this structure to import official past papers and step-by-step solutions:

```json
[
  {
    "subjectCode": "MAT-10",
    "prepClass": 10,
    "examYear": 2024,
    "title": "March 2024 Tamil Nadu State Board Public Exam Paper",
    "board": "Tamil Nadu State Board",
    "sourceInfo": "Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE) Official Public Paper",
    "paperType": "PUBLIC_EXAM",
    "maxMarks": 100,
    "durationMinutes": 150,
    "isPublished": true,
    "solution": {
      "title": "Official Step-by-Step Worked Solutions — March 2024",
      "solutionType": "TEXT_STEP_BY_STEP",
      "content": "### Part I: 1-Mark Objective Questions\n\n1. **Q1:** If $n(A \\times B) = 6$ and $A = \\{1, 3\\}$, find $n(B)$.\n   - **Answer:** 3\n   - **Working:** $n(A \\times B) = n(A) \\times n(B) \\implies 6 = 2 \\times n(B) \\implies n(B) = 3$.\n\n---\n\n### Part II: 2-Mark Short Answer Questions\n\n2. **Q2:** Determine whether the relation $R = \\{(1, 2), (2, 3), (1, 3)\\}$ is transitive.\n   - **Solution:** For all $(a, b) \\in R$ and $(b, c) \\in R$, $(a, c)$ must be in $R$. Since $(1, 2) \\in R$, $(2, 3) \\in R$, and $(1, 3) \\in R$, the relation is **transitive**.",
      "isPublished": true
    }
  }
]
```

---

#### 3. Examination Schedules & Test Questions JSON (`type: "exams"`)

Use this structure to schedule tests and load questions into the candidate testing engine:

```json
[
  {
    "subjectCode": "MAT-10",
    "prepClass": 10,
    "examDate": "2026-11-15T09:30:00.000Z",
    "durationMinutes": 90,
    "totalMarks": 50,
    "instructions": "All questions are compulsory. Read each question carefully before selecting an answer in the palette. Auto-save is active throughout the test.",
    "status": "PUBLISHED",
    "questions": [
      {
        "questionNumber": 1,
        "questionText": "If $A = \\{a, b, p\\}$, $B = \\{2, 3\\}$, and $C = \\{p, q, r, s\\}$, what is $n[(A \\cup C) \\times B]$?",
        "marks": 2,
        "options": [
          { "id": "A", "text": "8" },
          { "id": "B", "text": "20" },
          { "id": "C", "text": "12" },
          { "id": "D", "text": "16" }
        ],
        "correctAnswer": "C",
        "explanation": "$A \\cup C$ contains 6 distinct elements. $B$ contains 2 elements. Therefore, $n[(A \\cup C) \\times B] = 6 \\times 2 = 12$."
      },
      {
        "questionNumber": 2,
        "questionText": "Find the 8th term of the Arithmetic Progression: $3, 7, 11, 15, \\dots$",
        "marks": 2,
        "options": [
          { "id": "A", "text": "31" },
          { "id": "B", "text": "35" },
          { "id": "C", "text": "28" },
          { "id": "D", "text": "32" }
        ],
        "correctAnswer": "A",
        "explanation": "First term $a = 3$, common difference $d = 4$. $t_8 = a + (8 - 1)d = 3 + 7(4) = 31$."
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

3. **Option C (Project Files)**: Save files as `syllabus.json`, `papers.json`, or `exams.json` in the project directory, and let me know to run the batch importer.

Whenever you have your JSON ready, send it over and we will ingest it immediately.

### Summary of Completed Requirements

#### 1. Admin Credentials Updated
- **Username**: `1`

#### 2. Button Text Hover & Click Visibility Fixed
- **Root Cause**: The `.btn-primary::before` pseudo-element had an absolute overlay that was obscuring text on hover/active states.
- **Fix**: Removed the conflicting pseudo-element in [globals.css](file:///d:/DYNAMIC%20EXAM%20SITE/src/app/globals.css) and updated [Button.jsx](file:///d:/DYNAMIC%20EXAM%20SITE/src/components/ui/Button.jsx) to enforce crisp, high-contrast text (`!text-white hover:!text-white active:!text-white`) across all button variants (`primary`, `secondary`, `amber`, `danger`, `success`, `outline`).

#### 3. Standard JSON Schema for Class 10 & 12 Syllabus
A dedicated import tool is now live at [`/coe-admin/import`](http://localhost:3000/coe-admin/import). The exact JSON structure required:

```json
{
  "subjectCode": "MAT-10",
  "prepClass": 10,
  "units": [
    {
      "unitNumber": 1,
      "title": "Relations and Functions",
      "chapters": [
        {
          "chapterNumber": 1,
          "title": "Ordered Pair & Cartesian Product",
          "tamilTitle": "வரிசைச் சோடி மற்றும் கார்டீசியன் பெருக்கல்",
          "description": "Definition of relations, representation of functions, and types of functions.",
          "estimatedPeriods": 12,
          "weightageMarks": 14
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
*Pre-configured 1-click templates for all Class 10 subjects (`MAT-10`, `SCI-10`, `SOC-10`, `ENG-10`, `TAM-10`) and Class 12 subjects (`MAT-12`, `PHY-12`, `CHE-12`, `BIO-12`, `ENG-12`) are built into `/coe-admin/import`.*

- Replaced 24-hour input with a **12-Hour AM/PM picker** (Date picker + Hour `01-12` + Minute `00, 15, 30, 45` + `AM/PM`).

  > *"Dear candidate, take a deep breath. Read each question carefully and calmly. Manage your time with confidence. Best wishes for your success!"*
- Displayed times format in 12-hour AM/PM with Indian locale (e.g. `2 Nov 2026, 3:30 pm`).

#### 5. Auth Bypass & Backdoors Closed
- **Next.js Edge Middleware** ([src/middleware.js](file:///d:/DYNAMIC%20EXAM%20SITE/src/middleware.js)) enforces authentication on all `/coe-admin/*`, `/student/*`, and `/api/admin/*` paths.
- **Client-Side Guard** ([AdminGuard.jsx](file:///d:/DYNAMIC%20EXAM%20SITE/src/components/auth/AdminGuard.jsx)) runs on mount for every admin page, immediately redirecting unauthenticated visitors to `/?redirect=...&reason=authentication_required`.
